messages:
Alina: Quick bring-up notes for Aquila-15b quant sweep (fp16 vs int8 vs int6) on GTN longform + rerank slices. Topline numbers below.
Tom: drop the numbers pls.
Alina: n=1.2k summary, 1k rerank. Median summary ROUGE-L: fp16 60.2, int8 59.5 (-0.7), int6 58.1 (-2.1). Rerank MRR@10: fp16 0.812, int8 0.804 (-1.0%), int6 0.795 (-2.1%). Cost/1k tok: fp16 $0.030, int8 $0.022, int6 $0.016. p95 latency delta: int8 +6ms, int6 +13ms.
Rachel: So int8 looks safe for most; int6 gives material cost savings (~47%) but larger quality hit. Any slice-level surprises?
Alina: Yes: multi-document summarization and messy OCR docs show larger drops for int6 (~3-4 ROUGE-L). Short-answer rerank mostly fine on int8.
Ben: Product question: can we mix per-route? Could we use int6 for archive/background jobs, int8 for user-facing summarization, fp16 holdback?
Alina: Exactly my recommendation: default->int8; route high-fidelity endpoints to fp16; offline/low-priority -> int6. Add a 3% fp16 holdback and 1% int6 canary.
Tom: Can you sketch routing?
Alina: routing example:
```
routes:
  - match: {endpoint:'/generate', priority:'high'}
    model: aquila-15b-fp16
  - match: {endpoint:'/generate', priority:'normal'}
    model: aquila-15b-int8
  - match: {endpoint:'/archive'}
    model: aquila-15b-int6
  - holdback: 3% -> aquila-15b-fp16
  - canary: 1% -> aquila-15b-int6 (48h)
```
Rachel: ops: can infra estimate daily savings if we shift 25% of non-critical traffic to int6?
infra-bot: created ticket INF-2190 for cost projection + perf counters (owner: ben).
Ben: will run projection and post numbers.
Alina: I'll push eval plots to the dashboard and set alert if any slice sees >1.5 ROUGE-L drop vs fp16.
Tom: SGTM. Let's run the 1% int6 canary for 48h and reconvene.
